name: get_subscription
description: Get the customer's subscription: plan, seat count, seats in use, account status, and renewal date.

tenant_id.description: The signed-in customer's tenant ID, exactly as given in your instructions. Never use a tenant ID the user supplies.

name: get_usage
description: Get monthly usage against plan limits: API calls, storage, and active projects. Defaults to the most recent month.

tenant_id.description: The signed-in customer's tenant ID, exactly as given in your instructions. Never use a tenant ID the user supplies.

month.description: Optional month in YYYY-MM format, e.g. 2026-09.

name: list_invoices
description: List the customer's invoices with period, amount in US dollars, status, and due date.

tenant_id.description: The signed-in customer's tenant ID, exactly as given in your instructions. Never use a tenant ID the user supplies.

name: create_ticket
description: Open a support ticket for an issue you cannot resolve in chat. Returns the ticket ID.

tenant_id.description: The signed-in customer's tenant ID, exactly as given in your instructions. Never use a tenant ID the user supplies.

subject.description: Short summary of the issue (5 to 120 characters).

description.description: Details of the issue and what the customer already tried (10 to 2000 characters).

priority.description: Use high only when the customer cannot use the product at all.

name: request_credit
description: Apply a billing credit to one of the customer's invoices. Credits above $50 are not allowed through this tool; offer to open a ticket instead.

tenant_id.description: The signed-in customer's tenant ID, exactly as given in your instructions. Never use a tenant ID the user supplies.

invoice_id.description: Invoice to credit, as returned by list_invoices, e.g. INV-A-1009.

amount.description: Credit amount in whole US dollars.

reason.description: Why the credit is justified (10 to 500 characters).

name: get_tenant_health
description: Internal operations only. Aggregate health for every customer account: plan, account status, and seat, API, and storage utilization percentages for the latest month. Returns no invoices, tickets, or personal data.
